articles.summary: Evercore announced today that John Vaske has joined the firm as a senior managing director in its chemicals investment banking group. He will be based in New York.
articles.title: John Vaske Joins Evercore as Senior Managing Director in the Chemicals Investment Banking Group

articles.summary: Evercore ISI ranked No. 1 among all firms on a weighted basis in the analyst rankings of the 2026 Extel (previously Institutional Investor) All-America Research Team survey, marking its fifth consecutive year in the top position. The weighted ranking assigns greater value to higher placements, with first-place rankings contributing more than second- and third-place rankings.
articles.title: Evercore ISI Ranked No. 1 on Weighted Basis in 2026 Extel All-America Research Analyst Survey

articles.summary: Evercore announced today that John Song and Jean Stack have joined the firm as senior managing directors in the industrials investment banking group, focused on aerospace & defense. Both will be based in the Washington, D.C. area, expanding Evercore’s presence in the region.
articles.title: John Song and Jean Stack Join Evercore as Senior Managing Directors to Expand the Aerospace & Defense Investment Banking Team

articles.summary: The third quarter brought further gains in equity markets, supported by accelerating investment in AI and resilient US growth. Valuations also became more reasonable as corporate earnings grew faster than share prices.
articles.title: Q3 2026 Market Outlook

articles.summary: Evercore today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Nigel Dawn and Naveen Nataraj as Co-Presidents of the firm, effective January 1, 2027. Mr. Dawn and Mr. Nataraj will report to Chairman and Chief Executive Officer John S. Weinberg, who will continue to lead Evercore, its Management Committee and the firm’s strategic direction. Evercore’s Board and Mr. Weinberg have agreed that he will serve as Chairman and CEO for at least the next three years.
articles.title: Evercore Appoints Nigel Dawn and Naveen Nataraj as Co-Presidents

articles.summary: Evercore announced today that Hans Vestberg has joined the firm as a senior advisor, based in New York.
articles.title: Hans Vestberg Joins Evercore as Senior Advisor

articles.summary: Evercore announced today that Philip von Malsen-Plessen has joined the firm as a senior managing director in its investment banking business. He will be based in Frankfurt, further strengthening Evercore’s presence in the DACH region, as the firm continues to deliver on its long-term growth ambitions for Europe.
articles.title: Philip von Malsen-Plessen Joins Evercore as Senior Managing Director in its Investment Banking Business
